Getting in touch

Email malfara.labs@gmail.com. There is no form on this page and no ticket system — mail reaches a person.

Inside the app the same route is “Info + privacy” on the home screen, then Support, which opens your mail app with the address already filled in. It works offline; sending waits for a connection.

What to include

  • Your phone model and OS version.
  • The app version, shown at the bottom of the “Info + privacy” sheet.
  • What you expected to happen, and what happened instead.

Please do not attach a photo of yourself unless it is genuinely necessary to explain the problem. Nothing about this app needs your picture, and a support mailbox is a worse place for one than your own phone.

Things worth knowing before you write

There is no account and no password, so there is nothing to reset and no login to recover.

Nothing you do in the app is stored anywhere but your own phone, which also means there is no history for anyone to look up on your behalf. Deleting the app removes everything it kept.

Previews are approximations on a photograph. How ink actually sits on skin is a conversation for a tattoo artist.
